algorithms.title: Treatment Area — MARCH Rapid Pass
algorithms.description: Per patient, then move to the next.
steps: M — Massive hemorrhage: tourniquet, packing, pressure dressing (note TQ time).
A — Airway: position, suction, NPA/OPA; recovery position for unconscious breathing patients.
R — Respiration: seal open chest wounds; decompress tension pneumothorax per protocol; O2 to the hypoxic.
C — Circulation: bleeding control first; IV/IO and fluids only when indicated; permissive hypotension in penetrating trauma per protocol.
H — Hypothermia/Head: insulate from ground, cover; protect airway in head injury.
Re-triage and hand to Transport when ready.

algorithms.title: Transport Officer — Loading Cycle
algorithms.description: Repeat until the scene is clear.
steps: Ask Treatment: who is next (priority order)?
Ask Med Comms: who can take what (red/yellow/green capacity)?
Call the next unit from staging to the loading zone.
Assign patient(s) + destination; brief the crew in one line.
Log tag # · category · unit · destination · time.
Notify hospital via Med Comms; update IC counts.
